actions.label: Add to list
actions.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add or restore one item on the person's shopping list. It adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

name.label: Item
name.description: What to buy, such as eggs or flour.
name.ask: What should I add to your shopping list?

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: How many or how much, as a number above 0. Leave it out when it doesn't matter.

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams, cups or cans. Leave it out for a plain count.

categoryKey.label: Category
categoryKey.description: Optional. The aisle's category key, such as produce or pantry.

iconKey.label: Icon
iconKey.description: Optional. The item's icon key, such as wheat or package.

idempotencyKey.label: Idempotency key
idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the item is added once.

ownerEmail.label: Owner
ownerEmail.description: Optional. Whose list, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts on their own list.

actions.label: Approve access
actions.description: Let this agent, app or device use your Spoonjoy account.
actions.agent: Approve a pending agent connection request, which gives that client access to the person's Spoonjoy account.

requestId.label: Request
requestId.description: The connection request's id, from start_agent_connection.

personOnly.reason: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can.
personOnly.how: with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them
